jobs.prompt: Create a reference-guided character asset of the UR-DIDACT from HALO 4, in the exact helmeted armored incarnation in the attached Kolby Jukes render. Preserve the imposing nonhuman armored proportions, narrow mask with warm amber eyes, segmented crown and pointed mouth guard, massive separated swept shoulder assemblies, layered graphite and silver biomechanical plates with burgundy gaps, fine amber luminous lines, long armored fingers and the distinctive feet. The bright cyan in the reference is rim lighting, not a new blue armor skin. Both arms in a calm commanding combat idle, one palm slightly extended toward screen right and the other lowered; keep armor masses unmerged, hands anatomically coherent. No held weapon, no telekinetic effect. He is the Halo 4 Ur-Didact, not Bornstellar or a generic armored knight. Deliver exactly ONE character, full body head to feet including every appendage, centered with at least 10 percent transparent empty margin on all sides. New static combat idle pose facing screen RIGHT, about 75 to 85 degrees from frontal, camera at torso height with minimal perspective for a 2D fighting game. Preserve the exact identity, model silhouette, proportions, left/right equipment and materials from the supplied canonical reference; target the named game incarnation without redesign or combining iterations. Crisp high-detail game-rendered finish, even neutral light, true transparent alpha PNG. No floor, background, cast shadow, inset, alternate view, labels, interface or duplicate figures.
